scripts.build:native: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh signed
scripts.build:native:adhoc: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh adhoc
scripts.build:dmg: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh dmg
scripts.check:native: vp run --cache build && cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint:native: vp run --cache build && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:native: vp run --cache build && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.test:smoke: vp run --cache build && cargo run --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example window_lifecycle_smoke
scripts.build:native:arm64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh signed arm64
scripts.build:native:x64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh signed x64
scripts.build:native:adhoc:arm64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh adhoc arm64
scripts.build:native:adhoc:x64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh adhoc x64
scripts.build:dmg:arm64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh dmg arm64
scripts.build:dmg:x64: vp run --cache build && sh scripts/build-macos.sh dmg x64
